description: Source code for a web scraper class 'NIHHealthyEating' that extracts recipe information from the 'healthyeating.nhlbi.nih.gov' website, including title, total time, yields, image, ingredients, instructions, nutrients, description, prep and cook times, serving size, recipe source, and recipe cards.

classes.name: NIHHealthyEating
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from the Healthy Eating NIH website.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the website.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe title.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Raises exception with the site name 'National Heart, Lung and Blood Institute'.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns total recipe time in minutes.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and returns the number of servings.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the full URL of the recipe image.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns a list of IngredientGroup objects representing ingredient sections.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of all ingredients as strings.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of nutrient information.

methods.name: recipe_cards
methods.description: Returns a list of recipe card dictionaries with size and URL.
